# attestation-token-endpoint

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/attestation-token-endpoint.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `attestation-token-endpoint` component of `servlets/pf-integration`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.servlet.clientregistration`: generated from its catalogue, [attestation-token-endpoint.json](../../servlets/pf-integration/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/attestation-token-endpoint.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `ATTESTATION_AUTH` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_HOSTED_AGENT` (system property `oidf.attestation.require_hosted_agent`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_HOSTED_AGENT`) | `false` | Whether an attested agent this authority does not host is refused (401); a hosted agent must be active and inside its notAfter whatever this says | **Not checked**: Anything but true, in any case, means false | Any | Yes |
| `oidf.mock.attesters` (system property) | Unset; a file path | A JWKS file of attester keys trusted directly, with no federation trust chain: a development and demo hook. The image no longer sets it from a file in the build context; a development deployment mounts the file and sets the property itself | **Not checked**: A file that cannot be read is ignored; one that can is trusted, with a warning | Not in production: any value | Yes |
| `oidf.attestation.required.claims` (system property `oidf.attestation.required.claims`, then env `OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED_CLAIMS`) | Unset; a list | The top-level claims every client attestation must carry, comma-separated, at the token-endpoint filter and the OGNL criterion alike (until 0.6.0 only the criterion read it); a client's attestation_required_claims adds to them. The image set workload until 0.6.0; set OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED_CLAIMS=workload to keep that | **Not checked**: Read as given; a claim no attester sends refuses every such client | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_ATTESTATION_REDECIDE_ON_REFRESH_TYPES` | `payment_initiation,account_information`; a list | The authorization_details types, comma-separated, whose refresh must repeat its authorization_details: the issued-details criterion (IssuedDetailsCriterion.withinCeiling on an access-token mapping) refuses a refresh that sends none for a grant holding a detail of one of them, so the client asks again with its details and PingFederate calls the RAR processor's enrich, and so the PDP, again. PingFederate reissues a bare refresh's stored details without asking (F-0105). Only mappings that carry the criterion apply it; blank sends no refresh back | **Not checked**: Read as given; a type no grant holds sends nothing back | Any | Yes |
